title: Predicted Kcnk5b (another longfin) K2P channel dimer (OpenFold3 + MSA): low interface confidence
evidence_kind: PREDICTED: a computed structure hypothesis, not an observed structure

model.name: OpenFold3 preview2 (Nebius MCP infer_openfold3_native), seed 42, 1 sample, PDB70 MSA
model.context: Kcnk5b (Q6PFU3) residues 1-265 x2 (transmembrane core). Boltz-2 refused the homodimer (same-sequence MSA check); its failure receipt is kept.

open_questions: Does a membrane-aware model or AlphaFold3 raise the interface confidence enough to place alf variants?
limitations: MSA is PDB70-only (structural database, 14-122 sequences), so homologous crystal structures may be templated.
Single sample; no MD run because the interface is not confident.
does_not_establish: conductance, gating or the effect of any fin-overgrowth allele
